record.paper_title: Some Open Questions on Anti-de Sitter Geometry
record.context_brief: Convex-core boundary metrics determine GHMC structure
record.original_question: Let S be a closed surface of genus at least 2, let T be its Teichmüller space, and let m_- and m_+ be two points of T. Is there a unique globally hyperbolic maximal compact anti-de Sitter structure h on M = S × R such that the induced hyperbolic metrics on the two connected components of the boundary of the convex core are m_- and m_+?

evidence.quote: Question 3.3. Let m−, m+ ∈ T . Is there a unique h ∈ GH such that the induced metric on the two connected components of the boundary of the convex core are m− and m+?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $S$ be a closed orientable surface of genus at least $2$, and let $\mathcal{T}(S)$ denote the Teichmüller space of $S$, i.e. the space of isotopy classes of hyperbolic metrics on $S$. A globally hyperbolic maximal compact (GHMC) anti-de Sitter structure on the $3$-manifold $M = S \times \mathbb{R}$ is a Lorentzian metric of constant sectional curvature $-1$ on $M$ such that $(M,h)$ is globally hyperbolic with a Cauchy surface homeomorphic to $S$, and is maximal (any isometric embedding into another globally hyperbolic anti-de Sitter spacetime with Cauchy surface $S$ is onto). For such a structure, the convex core $C(M,h)$ is the smallest nonempty closed convex subset of $M$ whose inclusion is a homotopy equivalence; when $C(M,h)$ has nonempty interior, its boundary has two connected components, each a pleated surface whose induced (intrinsic) metric is hyperbolic and thus defines a point of $\mathcal{T}(S)$.

Question: Given any two points $m_-, m_+ \in \mathcal{T}(S)$, does there exist a unique GHMC anti-de Sitter structure $h$ on $M = S \times \mathbb{R}$ such that the induced hyperbolic metrics on the two connected components of $\partial C(M,h)$ are $m_-$ and $m_+$?
artifact.status_search_result: Existence of a GHMC AdS structure realizing any prescribed pair $(m_-, m_+)$ was established by Diallo. Rigidity (uniqueness) has been proved only in special cases: near the Fuchsian locus (Bonsante–Schlenker, and recent work by Prosanov for convex spacelike boundaries with holonomy close to Fuchsian). The full uniqueness statement remains open in general.

status_evidence.title: Rigidity of anti-de Sitter (2+1)-spacetimes with convex boundary near the Fuchsian locus
status_evidence.snippet: The realization of the induced metrics was established by Diallo... rigidity near the Fuchsian locus was also deduced. However, the rigidity parts of these problems remain open in general.
status_evidence.claim: Existence is known (Diallo); uniqueness/rigidity proved only near the Fuchsian locus and remains open generally.

status_evidence.title: Rigidity of anti-de Sitter (2+1)-spacetimes with convex boundary near the Fuchsian locus (J. London Math. Soc., 2026)
status_evidence.snippet: GHMC AdS spacetimes with strictly convex spacelike boundary whose holonomy is close to Fuchsian are determined by the induced metric on the boundary.
status_evidence.claim: Recent partial uniqueness result near the Fuchsian locus.
